physicalNotes: No radius or mass of Virgo Cluster is recorded: it is an extended cluster of galaxies, and its package frames it at 1625000 pc (object.json worldFrame.bodyRadiusM), a presentation value.

sources.position: Sadibekova et al. (2024), MCXC-II, A&A 688 A187; CDS J/A+A/688/A187, byte columns defined by https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/ftp/J/A+A/688/A187/ReadMe (https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/ftp/J/A+A/688/A187/mcxcii.dat.gz); catalogue reference mcxc-ii:MCXC J1230.7+1220

(2023), Cosmicflows-4, ApJ 944, 94; CDS J/ApJ/944/94, tables 2 (group membership, 1PGC) and 3 (group distance modulus, DMzp), as joined into the Nearby Universe's tracked table (https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/viz-bin/cat/J/ApJ/944/94); catalogue reference cosmicflows-4:41220: 16203170.427400004 pc; Cosmicflows-4 group distance: the weighted average of its members' distance moduli on the calibrated scale (table 3, DMzp).
